scope: Offline integration using the verified local overlay object store; simulated local coordinator/registry, not a live deletion proposal or remote restore

requiredBeforeAnyDeletion: Review retention policy and exact retirement list
Stop new mutation/publication work and drain in-flight operations under a renewable fence
Re-list metadata and re-check all coordinator, operation, publication and backup roots
Verify retained pack contents and perform an independent restore
Reverify fail-closed write admission together with the cleanup/reconciliation protocol; deletion alone is not a cost cap
limitations: This offline planner performs no cloud mutation/deletion or runtime change
No ZIP/content or local backup decoding by this planner; overlay raw hashes verify metadata identity, not content semantics
Inventory is not atomic; complete coordinator roots are required, but in-flight R2 operation and external-writer graphs are not captured
Proposed storage savings are not billing savings or a free-tier guarantee
